# Shi Ke (施可)

> Serial entrepreneur, founder of Dropleap (水滴跃动), authorized WorkBuddy agent, and manufacturing AI implementation provider in Suzhou. 16 years across software engineering, internet products, entrepreneurship, and business operations.

施可 (Shi Ke) is a serial entrepreneur with an MSc in Software Engineering from the University of Science and Technology of China (USTC). His career path spans software engineer → engineering manager → product lead → founder → COO → enterprise AI founder.

## Identity

- **Name**: 施可 (Shi Ke)

## Current focus

Building Dropleap (水滴跃动), an enterprise AI implementation company. Services span AI training, data integration, knowledge base systems, and custom AI applications, with an emphasis on reliability, observability, evaluability, and long-term operability in real business environments.

Flagship vertical: manufacturing AI implementation through the WorkBuddy authorized-agent relationship.

## Manufacturing AI focus

- **Identity**: Authorized agent for WorkBuddy in manufacturing. Operating brand: 苏州水滴跃动科技有限公司 (Suzhou Dropleap Technology).
- **Starting position**: get AI running inside the customer's factory within 2–4 weeks.
- **The WorkBuddy set of four**: Desktop AI (conversational entry point, installed inside the customer's own environment — data never leaves it), Data Retrieval (connected to ERP / CRM / MES and finance data, computed on one agreed definition), Enterprise Knowledge Base (process standards, work instructions, equipment manuals and policies, with answers carrying the original citation), and Monthly Operations Report (revenue, gross margin, receivables days, inventory and capacity, exported as PDF).
- **Two core Skills**: Data Retrieval Skill + Knowledge Base Skill. Deployed once and live throughout.
- **Delivery cadence**: 2–4 weeks to the first scenario running in production with measurable results; delivered on site with the customer's team; phase-gated — the next step is agreed only after the first scenario is accepted.
- **Training tracks**: Enterprise training (all staff, L1-L4 role tiers, 1-30 days); WorkBuddy training (middle and senior managers, M1-M4 tiers, 2-5 days); FDE engineer training (engineers with 1-10 years of experience, P1-P4 stages, 4-12 weeks, covering full delivery from PoC to production).
- **Industries served**: smart manufacturing, precision parts, industrial parts distribution, smart warehousing, battery and energy storage, chain restaurants, coffee platforms, home and building materials, logistics tech.
- **Footprint**: 100+ manufacturing enterprises served.

## Client cases (anonymized)

- **Industrial fastener and sealing distributor** (~RMB 250M annual revenue): connected ERP and customer data; launched AI quoting, an inventory alert dashboard, churn warning and an executive cockpit. Quote cycle 3 days → 15 minutes; slow-moving inventory down 25%; customer churn down 30%. Customer quote: "Quoting speed is our biggest competitive advantage right now." — CEO.
- **Precision parts maker for automotive and aerospace** (300 staff, ~RMB 180M annual output): connected order, production-line and QC data; launched a process knowledge base, traceability dashboard, predictive maintenance and operations diagnostics. New-hire ramp-up 3 months → 3 days; batch traceability 99.2%; unplanned downtime down 45%. Customer quote: "The master craftsmen's experience is finally captured." — Head of Digitalization.

Client names are anonymized by agreement; figures are results already delivered, not commitments.

## Career path

- 2026–present — Founder, Dropleap (水滴跃动). Enterprise AI implementation for manufacturing: WorkBuddy authorized-agent delivery on a 2–4 week cadence.
- 2022–2026 — COO, Linhuiba. Owned key-account operations and a replicable single-store model; built the KA service system from 0→1, served brand clients across automotive, tea and dining, and retail. Built the Location AI site intelligence platform from 0→1 and established a joint research center with Zhejiang University.
- 2021–2022 — Head of Product, Hellobike Hotel (Hellobike / 哈啰出行). Core BU decision-maker; built B-side and C-side product systems and membership growth loops.
- 2016–2021 — Head of Product & Head of Technology, Tongcheng-Elong (HK:0780), International Hotels division.
- 2015–2016 — Founder, Ball Chief Tribe (苏州踢来踢去网络). Built the venture from 0→1 and raised a RMB 3M institutional angel round from Zihui Ventures at a RMB 20M post-money valuation.
- 2009–2014 — Software Engineer → Tech Manager at NCS (Singtel Group) and Founder International. Delivered enterprise projects including Yum! Brands' franchise development system and completed multiple Singapore implementation assignments.

## Expertise

- **Enterprise AI Implementation**: Use-case discovery, AI strategy, Agent solution design, engineering delivery, deployment operations, reliability, observability, and evaluation
- **AI Agent / LLM Engineering**: LLM application development, Multi-Agent orchestration, Tool Use and Function Calling, RAG, agent evaluation and observability
- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**: Brand facts, content structure, authority signals, and continuous evaluation designed for accurate understanding, credible citation, and consistent recommendation by AI search engines
- **Product 0→1**: User insight → PRD → MVP → scaled iteration through a cross-functional engineering, product, and business lens
- **Venture Building & Business Operations**: Team formation, institutional funding, organizational alignment, enterprise operations, and repeatable delivery systems
- **Writing & Speaking**: Books and industry talks on AI productization, frontline delivery, product methodology, and business practice

## Ventures & products

- **微盟星启 GEO (Weimob Xingqi GEO)** — https://www.xingqigeo.cn/ — Weimob Group's Generative Engine Optimization platform, lifting brand reach and acquisition across AI search engines. Shi Ke is an authorized agent.
- **呼波特 WhoBot** — https://www.whobot.com/ — LLM-powered 24/7 AI phone agent for outbound calling and customer operations. Shi Ke is an authorized agent.
- **NihaoVisit** — https://www.nihaovisit.com/ — Practical China travel guides for foreign visitors; structured long-form content covering major China destinations and on-the-ground tips.
- **Liora Moon** — https://lioramoon.com/ — AI Tarot reading platform for personalized insights, daily cards, and AI reader chat.
- **FanTown (聚星动力)** — licensed sports and event retail operations, including the 2026 World Cup licensed pop-up store tour.

## Selected operations case

- **2026 World Cup licensed pop-up stores · 3-city tour** — Riding the 2026 FIFA World Cup, landed officially licensed pop-up stores across three cities: Changzhou Jiangnan Global Harbor (outdoor plaza), Wuxi LIVAT Shopping Centre (indoor atrium), and Shanghai CapitaMall Hongkou Dragon Dream (next to Hongkou Football Stadium). Operated by FanTown (聚星动力); carried licensed national-team jerseys, player memorabilia, figures, and trading cards (Argentina, Portugal, France, etc.), paired with photo installations and a cross-city card-collection campaign that turned event traffic into measurable footfall and sales.
